scope: seven CIX-owned adapter public headers; no vendor headers
basis: adapter-sonar-context-probe-v4 cxx:UndocumentedApi findings and reviewed source contracts

files.noncomment_change: The previously unnamed `GetCixCompressionManagerStatsV1` shared_ptr parameter is named `manager` so Doxygen can bind `@param manager`; parameter names do not affect the C++ ABI.

contract_recheck.profile_written: Encode and both decode entry points require a non-null written pointer; when supplied it is zeroed before validation. The applied Doxygen says this explicitly.
contract_recheck.profile_workspace: decode_workspace_size returns the required model byte count; decode_with_workspace also requires uint32_t alignment, a sufficient non-overlapping caller-owned range, and retains none of it.
contract_recheck.rocksdb: Factory admits only 1..128 MiB and returns nullptr on invalid cap/allocation failure. Statistics are atomic individual loads, not a coherent aggregate.
contract_recheck.gio: Constructor owns one native stream through GObject finalization; cancel is an atomic request fence only and does not preempt a call.
